from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A party involved in the case, including their role."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Full name or identifier of the party (e.g., '卢某', '广州诺德投资有限公司')")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Role in the case, e.g., 'Appellant' (上诉人), 'Appellee' (被上诉人), 'Reapplicant' (再审申请人)")

class CostRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record of court fees or costs and who bears them."""
    type: str | None = Field(description="Type of cost, e.g., '受理费', '保全费', '执行费'")
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The specific amount with currency unit as written in text (e.g., '4389 元', '1 万元')")
    borne_by: str | None = Field(description="Who bears this cost (party name or 'All')")

class CompensationRecord(BaseModel):
    """An order for monetary compensation or damages."""
    amount: str | None = Field(description="Compensation amount with currency unit (e.g., '1 万元')")
    payee: str | None = Field(description="Who receives the compensation")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who is ordered to pay")

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="Title or identifier of the document (e.g., '《判决文书1》')")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Cause of action or case type (e.g., '返还原物纠纷', '商业秘密纠纷')")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(default_factory=list, description="List of all parties identified in the document")
    outcome_summary: str | None = Field(description="The court's final decision disposition (e.g., '驳回上诉，维持原判', '撤销原判')")
    case_numbers: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Relevant case numbers cited in the document")
    court_costs: list[CostRecord] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Details of litigation fees, including amounts and bearers")
    compensation_orders: list[CompensationRecord] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Details of any compensation orders, including amounts and parties")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregation of extracted data from a single parsed document."""
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
